messages:
Maria: FYI coordinating Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector for the April go-live. Need: 1) integration test matrix, 2) docs owner, 3) joint announcement timeline, 4) HW perf notes for DGX pilot. @AJ @Samira can you pick owners? :eyes:
AJ: I can own the integration test matrix. I'll sketch smoke tests and perf targets. Do we have sample datasets? @Leo can you share the 10k-doc sample?
Samira: I'll take docs and release notes. Need final API surface + example snippets by Fri.
Leo: uploading sample set to s3://redwood-partner/snow-dbx-samples v2. Added README. Also adding a small ingestion script:
```bash
python ingest_sample.py --source s3://redwood-partner/snow-dbx-samples/v2 --dest snowflake --schema minimal
```
Jing: For announcement cadence - propose internal dry run on Tue, partner dry run Wed, public announcement Thu. Thoughts? :calendar:
PartnerBot: reminder: marketplace listing preflight checklist due in 4 days. See https://internal.redwood/checklists/connector-listing
Maria: AJ/Samira confirm owners? Also need SI contact list for Databricks SI - @Leo can you DM me the SI POC? If DGX perf looks off we might push to dedicated bundle.
AJ: confirmed. I'll post the initial matrix by EOD today and create a short runbook for flaky cases.
Samira: confirmed. Will draft docs PR and ping eng-docs for review. Will add release & partner-facing FAQ.
Leo: DM sent to Maria. sample upload complete. Quick note: Qdrant ingestion currently needs schema tweak (embedding dim mismatch) — adding fix in repo.
Maria: thanks all. I'm tracking in the partner board: https://board.redwood/boards/123. If anything blocks your owners flag it here, otherwise we'll do the dry runs as planned. :rocket:
